why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the web app Go to the EVAA web app to use the lending protocol from a browser.
2 Step 2 : Or use it in Telegram EVAA also runs as a Telegram Mini App, reached from the Open in Telegram button on the EVAA homepage .
3 Step 3 : Use a TON wallet The homepage says EVAA supports TON Space, Telegram's non-custodial wallet, so you can manage assets without leaving Telegram.
4 Step 4 : Choose to deposit or borrow Pick an asset the app supports and either deposit it to earn interest or borrow against what you hold.
5 Step 5 : Look at the EVAA Card Open the EVAA Card page if you want to see how spending against a deposit works.
